profile.name: Your Name
profile.role: Video Editor · VFX Artist · 3D & Game Designer
profile.bio:
I'm a media student who edits, composites and builds worlds. I cut short films and reels, and I'm going deeper into VFX: tracking, keying, CG integration and clean breakdowns.

Right now I'm looking for a **VFX internship** where I can learn from a real pipeline and ship shots.

projects.title: Transparent Hologram Laptop
projects.summary: Green laptop screen turned into see-through glass with a hologram desktop.
projects.description:
Replaced a green laptop screen with a transparent display showing a hologram desktop UI with ripples and neon glow.

- Planar track + corner pin of the screen
- Clean plate to see through the glass
- Glow, ripple and light-wrap passes

projects.title: VoxelHop: a game inside the screen
projects.summary: A voxel road-crossing game composited onto a real laptop, driven by real key presses.
projects.description: Variant of the hologram laptop shot: an original voxel road-crossing game lives on the screen, and the bunny hops in sync with the WASD keys pressed in the footage.

projects.title: Anywhere Door (previs)
projects.summary: Previs for a live-action Doraemon portal shot: four walkers, four elemental worlds.
projects.description: Locked-off shot with the door at frame centre. Each walker crosses the door plane, transforms, and the world on the other side switches to their element: Fire, Ice, Nature, Storm.

projects.title: Aadi & Chintu: short film
projects.summary: Live-action short about a street kid and his teddy saving ₹200 for a cinema ticket.
projects.description: A team short film shot on FX6 and a7 IV. Under-10-minute cut with dialogue synced from separate recorders.
